subject: Hosted API commit: uptake acceleration and rateband redesign
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@marketlynx.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-11-20T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Renewal coming up — exploring bigger monthly commit + softburst

Hi Vanessa,

Our annual term with Redwood expires Dec 15 — we've been reviewing October usage and expect a >2.5x sustained uplift through Q2 next year. We're interested in a renewal that increases our hosted monthly commit and reworks rate bands to avoid throttling during promo spikes.

High-level ask: can you send a proposal that shows (a) new monthly committed tokens, (b) burst pocket sizing and pricing, and (c) a repricing of the per-token tiers for the higher commit? We'd like to keep latency SLOs (p95 < 250ms) and add a small softburst for seasonal spikes.

CCing Marco (ops) for any technical Qs on KV cache/hot-prefix concerns.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

— Elena
Elena Morales
Head of Product Ops, MarketLynx
elena.morales@marketlynx.com
(415) 555-0194

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@marketlynx.com>
Cc: Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@marketlynx.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T09:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal coming up — exploring bigger monthly commit + softburst

Elena — great to hear from you and congrats on the growth. I've put together a short outline below for an accelerated renewal that preserves p95 latency and reduces unit cost as you scale.

Proposal summary (high level):
- Monthly commit: increase from 800M tokens -> 2.0B tokens (12-month term)
- Burst pocket: 20% of monthly commit available as softburst (pay-as-used at reduced overage rate)
- Tiered unit pricing: wholesale bands with stepped per-million pricing beyond commit; blended per-token figure ~30% lower than current effective rate at your projected volumes
- SLA: p95 latency target preserved; dedicated priority routing during scheduled promos; optional dedicated pool for peak lanes (add-on)

Next steps:
1) I'll share a formal term sheet and sample invoice (pdf) — need to confirm approval path (legal & procurement).
2) If ops wants, we can run a short KV cache audit to validate prefix hit rates; engineering can propose cache warming options pre-surge.

Can we target a decision by Dec 6 to hit a Dec 15 renewal? If that timeline works I'll loop in Karthik for pricing and Lauren for onboarding cadence.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: Hosted_Tier_Terms_v3.pdf (pdf, 72KB)

Subject: Internal: MarketLynx renewal — pricing ask and ops requirements

Karthik / Lauren — quick internal thread to align on a term-sheet we can send Elena by EOD 11/23. Key points:

What they want:
- Commit uplift to 2.0B tokens/month (12-mo)
- Softburst ~20% with capped overage rate (lower than on-demand)
- Preserve p95 latency <250ms; prefer routing priority (hosted) over full Dedicated unless cost-prohibitive

Pricing suggestion (draft):
- Committed bucket: $1.75 per 1k tokens for first 1.0B, $1.45 per 1k tokens for next 1.0B (blended to target ~30% discount vs current effective)
- Softburst overage: $2.10 per 1k tokens up to 20% of monthly commit (applies only to promotional burst window)
- Optional dedicated pool: add-on fee + reserved capacity discount (include APAC/region note if needed later)

Ops notes:
- Recommend a 7-day cache-warming window before first promo; engineering can provision prefix-level warming and temporary KV pinning.
- Instrument a short Eval run on the Canary model variant to measure end-to-end p95 under 50% scaled traffic.

Can you draft a short term-sheet and updated invoice? Lauren, please propose an onboarding timeline (kickoff -> runbook handoff -> first-week support rota).

Thanks — V

— vanessa

- A short Ops checklist listing cache-warm steps and what Redwood needs from our side (temps/URLs, expected promo dates).
